conclusion: The index reader's installed function-pointer table is joined to an initializer that clears its incoming object's +0x434 field. A separate initializer installs a distinct table and stores 0x8314F0A8 at the same offset. Two callers in sub_82DF91F8 construct the reader-table object and next dispatch slot +0x2C; that target and the initializer's direct helper chain add no identified +0x434 writer before further indirect calls. The enclosing function has no proved natural gameplay trigger. The reader object's later nonzero pointer producer, live index range, and any copied-word use remain unresolved.
